tickets.title: Review Financial Plan Snapshot
tickets.text: Refresh key assumptions, compare current projections to stated goals, note material changes in income, expenses, taxes, assets, liabilities, retirement timing, and education funding needs, then list planning decisions for advisor review. This refresh is for the Bramblequill household (Nora, Ellis, and Lila Bramblequill) following their relocation from Nashville, TN to Asheville, NC, incorporating the new $885,000 home with $622,000 mortgage at 6.125%, $13,200 monthly spending, $184,000 cash reserves, $1.36M investments, Nora's $218,000 salary with 20% bonus, Ellis's $146,000 salary, and Lila's 529 education funding.
tickets.evidence: After Nora requested updated affordability and long-term projections, the agreed follow-up is to refresh the household plan for North Carolina residency, Asheville housing costs, revised commuting expenses, cash reserve targets, retirement savings, and Lila’s education funding assumptions by 2025-10

tickets.title: Conduct Benefits Enrollment Outreach
tickets.text:
Outreach purpose: benefits enrollment support for Bramblequill household (Ellis Bramblequill).

Message outline:
1. Confirm the enrollment window or relative deadline: before the election window closes (by 2025-09-30).
2. Request current benefits materials: benefits guide, rate sheet, and portal summary.
3. Ask about expected changes: [FAMILY STATUS / HEALTH NEEDS / DEPENDENTS / EMPLOYMENT / CASH FLOW].
4. Identify decisions to review: HSA, disability coverage, supplemental life insurance, and retirement contribution choices.
5. If contacting a benefits professional, request clarification on: [PLAN RULES / EMPLOYER MATCH / COVERAGE EFFECTIVE DATE / ELIGIBILITY].
6. Close with next step: [SCHEDULE REVIEW / UPLOAD DOCUMENTS / CONFIRM ELECTIONS].

Reusable note: Do not provide final election instructions until plan documents and client priorities have been reviewed. This review is for Ellis Bramblequill's Cloudberry Kite Analytics benefits ahead of the enrollment deadline.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review Ellis’s Cloudberry Kite Analytics benefits guide, rate sheet, and portal summary against HSA, disability coverage, supplemental life insurance, and retirement contribution choices by 2025-09-30 before the election window closes.
